calls.title: GrowthBook <> Cloud Imperium Games - Intro
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Daniel Wathne and Logan Bates discussed their feature flagging and experimentation platform with Cloud Imperium Games' Martin Le Bas, Jocelyn Menard, and Emilien Pierru. CIG’s pain points include a decentralized internal badge system for feature flags and a lack of centralized AB testing, especially for their player acquisition flow.
